title: A small animal, not a slow one
question: You said the shrink looked good and you wanted to move a bit faster. Same script, same ground, same 120 ticks, both clips. Is this the faster you meant, or should she go further still?
context_md:
The old small gnome covered **exactly as many of her own body-lengths per tick as the tall one** -- 0.043 both. That is the whole defect in one number: she was a shrunk *picture* of the gnome rather than a small creature, so everything took four and a half times as long.

Now she scurries: 0.093 of her own lengths a tick, a bit over twice the tall gnome's gait, while still being slower than him in plain world cells (0.28 against his 0.60). She also gets going in 6 ticks instead of 12 -- a small thing accelerates hard, because gravity did not shrink with her.

items.label: before
